33363.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ARG` — faqat build paytida mavjud o'zgaruvchi, `ENV` — build'da ham, ishlayotgan container'da ham. Secret'ni `ARG` bilan berish xavfli, chunki qiymat image metadata'sida (`docker history`) va uni ishlatgan layer'da qoladi.

**Muammo:** Private npm registry tokenini `ARG NPM_TOKEN` bilan berdingiz. Image public registry'ga chiqdi — har kim `docker history --no-trunc` bilan tokenni o'qiydi.

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
ARG GO_VERSION=1.25
FROM golang:${GO_VERSION} AS build
ARG VERSION=dev                       # build-time
ENV CGO_ENABLED=0                     # build + runtime
RUN go build -ldflags "-X main.version=${VERSION}" -o /app .
```
```bash
docker build --build-arg VERSION=1.4.0 -t api .
docker history --no-trunc api | grep VERSION   # ARG qiymati ko'rinadi!
```

| | ARG | ENV |
|---|---|---|
| Build vaqtida | bor | bor |
| Container ishlayotganda | yo'q | bor |
| Qanday beriladi | `--build-arg` | Dockerfile, `-e`, compose |
| `docker history`da | ishlatilgan RUN bilan ko'rinadi | ko'rinadi |

**To'g'ri yo'l — BuildKit secret:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci
```
```bash
docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc .
```
Secret faqat shu `RUN` davomida fayl sifatida mount qilinadi, hech qaysi layer'ga yozilmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `FROM` dan oldingi `ARG` keyingi bosqichda ko'rinmaydi — bosqich ichida qayta `ARG NAME` yozing.
- `ENV PASSWORD=...` — runtime'da `docker inspect` bilan ham ko'rinadi.
- `ARG` o'zgarsa — undan keyingi layer cache'i buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Runtime secret'lar image'ga umuman kirmasligi kerak — orchestrator secret (K8s Secret + External Secrets, Vault) orqali beriladi. CI'da gitleaks/trivy secret scan qo'ying.

33364.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `COPY` — context'dan fayllarni oddiy ko'chiradi. `ADD` — qo'shimcha ravishda lokal tar arxivni avtomatik ochadi va URL'dan yuklay oladi. Deyarli doim `COPY` ishlating; `ADD` faqat lokal tar'ni ochish kerak bo'lganda.

**Nega:** `ADD` "sehrli" — `app.tar.gz` ni ko'chirmoqchi bo'lsangiz, u ochib yuboradi. URL'dan yuklashda checksum va cache nazorati yo'q. Aniq xatti-harakat uchun `COPY`.

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
COPY go.mod go.sum ./                  # oddiy
COPY --chown=10001:10001 . .           # egasini belgilash
COPY --from=build /app /app            # multi-stage
ADD rootfs.tar.gz /                    # tar avtomatik ochiladi - ADD o'rinli
```
URL'dan yuklash — `RUN` bilan, checksum tekshirib:
```dockerfile
RUN curl -fsSL -o /tmp/tool.tgz https://example.com/tool-1.2.tgz \
 && echo "ab12...ef  /tmp/tool.tgz" | sha256sum -c - \
 && tar -xzf /tmp/tool.tgz -C /usr/local/bin && rm /tmp/tool.tgz
```
Yangi Dockerfile sintaksisida `ADD --checksum=sha256:... <url> /dst` ham bor.

| | COPY | ADD |
|---|---|---|
| Lokal fayl | ha | ha |
| Tar avto-ochish | yo'q | ha |
| URL | yo'q | ha |
| Bashorat qilish | oson | kutilmagan |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ADD https://...` — har build'da qayta yuklanmasligi yoki aksincha, kutilmaganda o'zgarishi mumkin.
- `COPY ../shared .` — context'dan tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi.
- `--chown` siz ko'chirilgan fayllar root'ga tegishli — non-root user yoza olmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** hadolint qoidasi DL3020: "fayl/papka uchun ADD emas COPY". Linter'ni CI'ga qo'ying — bunday mayda xatolarni code review'ga qoldirmang.

33365.a:
```sh
docker ps -a                              # STATUS: Exited (code)
docker logs <id>
docker inspect <id> --format '{{.State.ExitCode}} {{.State.OOMKilled}}'
docker run -it --entrypoint sh myimage    # ichiga kirib qo'lda ishga tushirish
```

| Belgi | Sabab |
|---|---|
| Exit 0, log bo'sh | Process fon'ga o'tdi (`nginx` → `daemon off;`, `service x start`) |
| Exit 1 | Config/env yo'q, DB'ga ulanmadi |
| Exit 127 | Binary topilmadi (alpine'da glibc binary, noto'g'ri path) |
| Exit 137 + OOMKilled | Memory limit |
| `exec format error` | Arxitektura mos emas (arm64 image amd64'da) |

**Qoida:** container'da bitta process foreground'da ishlaydi; `tail -f /dev/null` bilan "tirik ushlash" — xato yashiradi.

33366.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Container o'z network namespace'ida ishlaydi, shuning uchun uning ichidagi `localhost` — container'ning o'zi, host emas. DB host'da `127.0.0.1:5432` da tinglayapti — container undan "connection refused" oladi. Yechim: DB'ga Docker DNS nomi yoki `host.docker.internal` orqali ulanish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
host netns:       postgres 127.0.0.1:5432
                     ^
                     x  (bu boshqa localhost)
container netns:  app -> localhost:5432 -> container o'zi -> refused
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# 1. DB ham container bo'lsa - bitta tarmoq, nom bilan
docker network create app
docker run -d --network app --name db -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=x postgres:17
docker run --network app -e DB_HOST=db myapp

# 2. DB host'da bo'lsa
docker run --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway \
  -e DB_HOST=host.docker.internal myapp
# va postgresql.conf: listen_addresses = '*' (yoki docker0 IP), pg_hba.conf'ga 172.17.0.0/16

# tekshirish
docker exec app getent hosts db
docker exec app nc -zv db 5432
```

| Holat | Yechim |
|---|---|
| DB ham container (Compose) | `DB_HOST=db` — servis nomi |
| DB host'da | `host.docker.internal` (Linux'da `host-gateway`) |
| Tez sinov | `--network host` (faqat Linux, prod uchun emas) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DB `listen_addresses=localhost` — `host.docker.internal` ham ishlamaydi.
- Teskari holat: ilova container ichida `127.0.0.1:8080` da tinglaydi — `-p 8080:8080` ishlamaydi; `0.0.0.0` ga bind qiling.
- Firewall host'da docker bridge'dan kelgan trafikni bloklashi.

**Senior nuqta:** Host konfiguratsiyasini kodga yozmang — `DB_HOST` env orqali bering. Host'dagi servisga container'dan ulanish odatda vaqtinchalik holat; uzoq muddatda DB'ni managed servis yoki alohida host'ga chiqaring.

33367.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Image'ni Trivy, Grype yoki Docker Scout bilan skanerlaysiz — ular OS paketlari va ilova dependency'larini CVE bazasi bilan solishtiradi. CI'da skaner `--exit-code 1` bilan HIGH/CRITICAL topilganda pipeline'ni yiqitadi, shunda zaif image registry'ga chiqmaydi.

**Muammo:** Base image'dagi eski `openssl` yoki `log4j` kritik zaiflik bilan prod'ga chiqib ketadi va buni hech kim bilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build -> image -> trivy (paketlar ro'yxati + CVE DB)
                    +-- CRITICAL/HIGH (fix bor) -> exit 1 -> pipeline to'xtaydi
                    +-- qolganlari -> report
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 registry/api:1.4.0
```
Chiqish:
```
registry/api:1.4.0 (debian 12.5)
Total: 2 (HIGH: 1, CRITICAL: 1)
| Library | Vulnerability  | Severity | Installed | Fixed   |
| libssl3 | CVE-2024-XXXX  | CRITICAL | 3.0.11-1  | 3.0.13-1|
```
`Fixed` ustuni — qaysi versiyaga yangilash kerakligini aytadi.

```yaml
# GitHub Actions
- uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
  with:
    image-ref: registry/api:${{ github.sha }}
    severity: HIGH,CRITICAL
    ignore-unfixed: true
    exit-code: "1"
```
Istisno `.trivyignore` da sabab bilan:
```
# CVE-2024-XXXX: kod yo'li ishlatilmaydi, 2026-12-01 gacha
CVE-2024-XXXX
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--ignore-unfixed` siz — tuzatib bo'lmaydigan CVE'lar pipeline'ni doim bloklaydi va jamoa skanerni o'chiradi.
- Faqat build paytida skanerlash — ertaga yangi CVE chiqadi, prod image'lar qayta skanerlanmaydi.
- Base image yangilandi, lekin sizning image avtomatik rebuild bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Gate + muntazamlik: CI'da blok, registry'da kunlik qayta skan, haftalik avtomatik rebuild (Renovate/Dependabot base image digest'ini yangilaydi). Minimal base (distroless) CVE sonini keskin kamaytiradi.

33368.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CI runner har safar toza — lokal layer cache yo'q, shuning uchun hamma narsa noldan quriladi. Tezlashtirish: o'lchash -> `.dockerignore` -> layer tartibi -> BuildKit cache mount -> remote cache (`--cache-from/--cache-to type=registry` yoki `type=gha`).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI job #1: build -> push image + push cache (registry/api:buildcache)
CI job #2: import cache -> faqat o'zgargan layer'lar quriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM golang:1.25 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    go build -o /app ./cmd/api
```
```bash
docker buildx build \
  --cache-from type=registry,ref=registry/api:buildcache \
  --cache-to   type=registry,ref=registry/api:buildcache,mode=max \
  -t registry/api:$SHA --push .
```
GitHub Actions:
```yaml
- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    push: true
    tags: registry/api:${{ github.sha }}
    cache-from: type=gha
    cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
```
O'lchash: `--progress=plain` chiqishida har qadam vaqti; `CACHED` qatorlar soni.

**Tartib (ta'sir bo'yicha):**
1. `.dockerignore` — `.git`, `node_modules`.
2. Dependency fayllari kod'dan oldin.
3. Remote cache — eng katta yutuq CI'da.
4. Cache mount — dependency o'zgarganda ham qisman qayta ishlatish.
5. Multi-stage — mustaqil bosqichlar parallel.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `mode=min` (default) — faqat yakuniy image layer'lari; multi-stage builder bosqichlari keshlanmaydi. `mode=max` kerak.
- `--mount=type=cache` remote cache'ga eksport qilinmaydi — u builder'da lokal.
- `--no-cache` yoki `--pull` ni har build'da yoqish.

**Senior nuqta:** Doimiy (persistent) builder — eng kuchli yechim: self-hosted runner'da uzoq yashaydigan buildkitd yoki Docker Build Cloud. Build vaqtini metrika sifatida kuzating — sekin regressiyani darhol ko'rasiz.

33369.a:
**Qisqa javob:** HashiCorp Vault — secret'larni markazlashgan, **shifrlangan** holda saqlaydigan, kim nimani o'qiganini **audit** qiladigan, path bo'yicha **policy** bilan ruxsat beradigan va hatto har so'rovga vaqtinchalik (**dynamic**) credential yaratadigan servis. `.env` — diskdagi ochiq matn fayl, nazorat va rotatsiyasiz.

**Muammo:** `.env` fayl serverda, laptoplarda, Slack'da, backup'larda nusxalanib ketadi. Parol o'zgarsa hamma joyni qo'lda yangilash kerak. Kim o'qiganini hech kim bilmaydi. Hodim ketsa — barcha parollarni bilib ketgan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ilova --(auth: K8s SA token / AppRole / OIDC)--> Vault
         <-- qisqa muddatli token (policy: secret/data/api/* read)
ilova --> GET secret/data/api      -> db_password
ilova --> GET database/creds/api   -> user=v-api-x7k, ttl=1h (dynamic)
                                       muddati tugasa Vault DB'dan user'ni o'chiradi
Hamma so'rov -> audit log
```

| | `.env` / config | Vault |
|---|---|---|
| Saqlash | ochiq matn diskda | shifrlangan |
| Kim o'qidi | noma'lum | audit log |
| Ruxsat | fayl huquqi | policy (path bo'yicha) |
| Rotatsiya | qo'lda, deploy bilan | avtomatik, TTL |
| Dynamic secret | yo'q | har ilova/so'rovga alohida |

**Amalda:**
```bash
vault kv put secret/api db_password='S3cr3t!'
vault kv get -field=db_password secret/api
vault policy write api - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/api" { capabilities = ["read"] }
EOF
vault read database/creds/api        # vaqtinchalik DB user
```
K8s'da: Vault Agent Injector, Vault Secrets Operator yoki External Secrets Operator orqali.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Vault'dan o'qib, yana `.env` faylga yozib qo'yish — foyda yo'qoladi.
- Root token'ni ishlatib yurish — faqat boshlang'ich sozlash uchun, keyin revoke.
- Unseal kalitlarini bitta odamda saqlash; auto-unseal (KMS) ishlat.
- Vault — kritik bog'liqlik: u yiqilsa ilovalar start bo'lmaydi; HA (Raft) va kesh kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Cloud ichida bo'lsangiz AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager odatda oddiyroq va ops yuki yo'q. Vault multi-cloud, on-prem va dynamic secret'lar haqiqatan kerak bo'lganda oqlanadi. (Litsenziya: Vault BSL ostida; ochiq fork — OpenBao.)

33370.a:
```
Pod (ServiceAccount JWT) --> Vault kubernetes auth --> TokenReview (K8s API) tasdiqlaydi
                                  |
                          role: api -> policy: read secret/data/api/*
                                  v
                         qisqa muddatli Vault token --> secret
```

```sh
vault write auth/kubernetes/role/api \
  bound_service_account_names=api bound_service_account_namespaces=prod \
  policies=api-read ttl=1h
```

Pod'ga yetkazish usullari: Vault Agent sidecar (faylga yozadi, yangilaydi), Vault CSI provider, yoki External Secrets Operator (K8s Secret'ga sinxronlaydi — oddiy, lekin Secret etcd'da qoladi).

**Middle nuqtalar:** policy least privilege (path bo'yicha), token TTL qisqa, audit device yoqilgan, Vault o'zi HA + unseal (auto-unseal KMS bilan).
